issue.title: test_sigterm_leaves_run_running exits 124 instead of 143 under a loaded full check

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1es.6--1 (notes #1/#2, 2026-10-02). In full `sase tool run check` run ed409dda657123458c685fbf09f595a4 (loadavg 40+), the test ended with exit 124 (timeout) instead of the expected 143 (SIGTERM). It passed solo in about 11s on the unchanged tree. The local failure ledger (`sase tool failures`, signature 5a48dc0b134e...) shows 2 failing runs from 2 agents in 2 workspaces, first seen 2026-10-01 16:18Z. That predates epic sase-1es, whose pager changes do not touch tool/inline-escalation code. Likely a fixed wall-clock timeout in the test that a loaded host exceeds before the SIGTERM path completes.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/tool/test_inline_escalation.py::test_sigterm_leaves_run_running (repeat under a loaded full check)

issue.creation_reason: A sase-1es.6 check run saw this tool test time out under load and pass solo; the failure ledger shows it on two agents since before that epic, with no bead tracking it.
